create_levit_config: create a LevitConfig instance with default levit-128S model configuration
create_levit_config_custom: create a LevitConfig with custom image_size, patch_size, hidden_sizes, and num_attention_heads
init_levit_model: initialize a LevitModel from a LevitConfig instance with random weights
access_levit_model_config: access the configuration from an initialized LevitModel via model.config
configure_levit_down_ops: configure LeViT down_ops automatically from key_dim and hidden_sizes in __post_init__
